title: A counting bound of $\binom{n}{2}$
statement:
Let $G$ be a multigraph whose (finite) vertex set has $n \ge 2$ elements, and let $m$ be a natural number. If
\[
  m \cdot \frac{2}{n(n-1)} \le 1,
\]
then $m \le \binom{n}{2}$.
hypotheses_covered: multigraph G with vertex count n
replaced:
Let $n = \abs{V(G)} \ge 2$. If a family of $\mathrm{numCuts}$ cuts is disjoint in the
sense that $\mathrm{numCuts} \cdot \frac{2}{n(n-1)} \le 1$, then
\[
  \mathrm{numCuts} \le \binom{n}{2} .
\]
